p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.label:
A machine outside the set of a job gets the time `D + 1`; a schedule within the threshold uses
only machines of the sets.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.tooltipHtml: A machine outside the set of a job gets the time D+1D + 1D+1; a schedule within the threshold uses only machines of the sets.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.label:
A machine outside the set of a job gets the time `D + 1`; a schedule within the threshold uses
only machines of the sets.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.tooltipHtml: A machine outside the set of a job gets the time D+1D + 1D+1; a schedule within the threshold uses only machines of the sets.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.label:
A machine outside the set of a job gets the time `D + 1`; the jobs of weight `0` outside their
sets are moved to the end.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.tooltipHtml: A machine outside the set of a job gets the time D+1D + 1D+1; the jobs of weight 000 outside their sets are moved to the end.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.label:
A machine outside the set of a job gets the time `d_j + 1`; the jobs outside their sets are not
just in time and are moved to the end.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibility.m.tooltipHtml: A machine outside the set of a job gets the time dj+1d_j + 1dj​+1; the jobs outside their sets are not just in time and are moved to the end.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.label:
The word map writes the time `D + 1` on the machines outside the set of every job, in
polynomial time on the word RAM.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.tooltipHtml: The word map writes the time D+1D + 1D+1 on the machines outside the set of every job, in polynomial time on the word RAM.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.label:
The word map writes the time `D + 1` on the machines outside the set of every job, in
polynomial time on the word RAM.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.tooltipHtml: The word map writes the time D+1D + 1D+1 on the machines outside the set of every job, in polynomial time on the word RAM.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.label:
The word map writes the time `D + 1` on the machines outside the set of every job, and the
threshold `-1` when a set is empty, in polynomial time on the word RAM.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.tooltipHtml: The word map writes the time D+1D + 1D+1 on the machines outside the set of every job, and the threshold −1-1−1 when a set is empty, in polynomial time on the word RAM.

p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.label:
The word map writes the time `d_j + 1` on the machines outside the set of job `j`, and the
threshold `-1` when a set is empty, in polynomial time on the word RAM.
p:Lax434175Proofs.EncodingsEligibilityWo.tooltipHtml: The word map writes the time dj+1d_j + 1dj​+1 on the machines outside the set of job jjj, and the threshold −1-1−1 when a set is empty, in polynomial time on the word RAM.
